knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=A named character vector of paths to the quantification files ;; type=The quantification software used, such as "salmon", "sailfish", "kallisto", "rsem", "stringtie", "alevin", "oarfish", or "none" ;; tx2gene=A two-column data.frame mapping transcript IDs (column 1) to gene IDs (column 2) ;; txIn=Logical, whether the input files are transcript-level (default TRUE) ;; txOut=Logical, whether to output transcript-level results instead of summarizing to gene-level (default FALSE) ;; countsFromAbundance=Character option to generate counts scaled from abundances ("no", "scaledTPM", "lengthScaledTPM", or "dtuScaledTPM") ;; ignoreAfterBar=Logical, whether to split transcript IDs at the first bar "|" character (useful for Gencode transcripts in Kallisto) ;; ignoreTxVersion=Logical, whether to ignore transcript version numbers during summarization ;; varReduce=Logical, whether to reduce inferential replicates to a single variance per transcript/gene and sample ;; dropInfReps=Logical, whether to skip importing inferential replicates ;; importer=A custom function to read in files, allowing advanced customization
- alternatives: tximeta=An extension of tximport that automatically adds annotation metadata and outputs a SummarizedExperiment object with GRanges for commonly used human and mouse transcriptomes (GENCODE, Ensembl, RefSeq)
- when_to_use: Use when you have transcript-level abundance estimates (TPM, estimated counts, effective lengths) from pseudo-aligners or quantifiers and want to perform gene-level or transcript-level differential expression analysis using DESeq2, edgeR, or limma-voom.
- pitfalls: Do not manually pass the original gene-level counts (txi$counts with countsFromAbundance="no") to downstream methods without an offset, as this fails to correct for differential isoform usage (unless using 3' tagged RNA-seq where gene length correction is not appropriate) ;; Ensure the column order of tx2gene is strictly: 1) transcript ID, 2) gene ID (column names do not matter, but order does) ;; Ensure transcript IDs in tx2gene match the IDs in the abundance files exactly (use ignoreAfterBar=TRUE or ignoreTxVersion=TRUE if needed to resolve mismatches) ;; Importing kallisto .h5 files requires the rhdf5 package to be installed

workflows.name: gene_level_import_and_deseq2
workflows.intent: Import transcript-level estimates, summarize them to the gene level, and prepare a DESeqDataSet for downstream differential expression analysis with DESeq2.
workflows.stages: 1. Locate quantification files and define sample names ;; 2. Read transcript-to-gene mapping table ;; 3. Import and summarize transcript-level estimates to gene-level using tximport ;; 4. Create a DESeqDataSet object using DESeqDataSetFromTximport
workflows.code:
library(tximportData)
dir <- system.file("extdata", package="tximportData")
samples <- read.table(file.path(dir,"samples.txt"), header=TRUE)
files <- file.path(dir, "salmon", samples$run, "quant.sf.gz")
names(files) <- paste0("sample",1:6)
library(readr)
tx2gene <- read_csv(file.path(dir, "tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv"))
library(tximport)
txi <- tximport(files, type="salmon", tx2gene=tx2gene)
library(DESeq2)
sampleTable <- data.frame(condition=factor(rep(c("A","B"),each=3)))
rownames(sampleTable) <- colnames(txi$counts)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, sampleTable, ~ condition)

workflows.name: gene_level_import_and_edger_limma
workflows.intent: Import transcript-level estimates, summarize them to the gene level, and prepare a DGEList object for downstream analysis with edgeR or limma-voom.
workflows.stages: 1. Locate quantification files and define sample names ;; 2. Read transcript-to-gene mapping table ;; 3. Import and summarize transcript-level estimates to gene-level using tximport ;; 4. Create a DGEList object using DGEListFromTximport
workflows.code:
library(tximportData)
dir <- system.file("extdata", package="tximportData")
samples <- read.table(file.path(dir,"samples.txt"), header=TRUE)
files <- file.path(dir, "salmon", samples$run, "quant.sf.gz")
names(files) <- paste0("sample",1:6)
library(readr)
tx2gene <- read_csv(file.path(dir, "tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv"))
library(tximport)
txi <- tximport(files, type="salmon", tx2gene=tx2gene)
library(edgeR)
dge <- DGEListFromTximport(txi)

workflows.name: transcript_level_import_and_summarization
workflows.intent: Import transcript-level estimates without gene-level summarization, with the option to summarize to gene-level later or perform transcript-level differential expression.
workflows.stages: 1. Import transcript-level estimates with txOut=TRUE ;; 2. Summarize transcript-level matrices to gene-level using summarizeToGene ;; 3. Alternatively, create a transcript-level DGEList with divided counts for edgeR
workflows.code:
library(tximportData)
dir <- system.file("extdata", package="tximportData")
samples <- read.table(file.path(dir,"samples.txt"), header=TRUE)
files <- file.path(dir, "salmon", samples$run, "quant.sf.gz")
names(files) <- paste0("sample",1:6)
library(tximport)
txi.tx <- tximport(files, type="salmon", txOut=TRUE)
library(readr)
tx2gene <- read_csv(file.path(dir, "tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv"))
txi.sum <- summarizeToGene(txi.tx, tx2gene)
library(edgeR)
dge.tx <- DGEListFromTximport(txi.tx, divide=TRUE)

workflows.name: rsem_import
workflows.intent: Import gene-level or isoform-level quantification results from RSEM.
input: sample.genes.results.gz (RSEM gene results) or sample.isoforms.results.gz (RSEM isoform results)
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to RSEM results files ;; 2. Import gene-level results with txIn=FALSE and txOut=FALSE, or import isoform-level results with txIn=TRUE and txOut=TRUE
workflows.code:
library(tximportData)
dir <- system.file("extdata", package="tximportData")
samples <- read.table(file.path(dir,"samples.txt"), header=TRUE)
files <- file.path(dir,"rsem", samples$run, paste0(samples$run, ".genes.results.gz"))
names(files) <- paste0("sample",1:6)
library(tximport)
txi.rsem <- tximport(files, type="rsem", txIn=FALSE, txOut=FALSE)
files <- file.path(dir,"rsem", samples$run, paste0(samples$run, ".isoforms.results.gz"))
names(files) <- paste0("sample",1:6)
txi.rsem <- tximport(files, type="rsem", txIn=TRUE, txOut=TRUE)

workflows.name: stringtie_import
workflows.intent: Import transcript coverage and abundance estimates from StringTie.
workflows.stages: 1. Read a sample file to extract transcript-to-gene mapping ;; 2. Import StringTie files using tximport with type="stringtie"
workflows.code:
tmp <- read_tsv(files[1])
tx2gene <- tmp[,c("t_name","gene_name")]
txi <- tximport(files, type="stringtie", tx2gene=tx2gene)

workflows.name: alevin_import
workflows.intent: Import single-cell RNA-seq gene-by-cell count matrices quantified with Alevin.
workflows.stages: 1. Define path to the Alevin quants matrix file ;; 2. Import the matrix using tximport with type="alevin"
